about: Volume for the fixture brain: three more projects, routine entries (weekly order numbers, closed tasks, posts, session logs), and entries that contradict older ones without superseding them. Written after brain.json.

projects.name: Workshops
projects.goal: Beginner pottery classes in the studio

engrams.title: hosting-costs
engrams.content: Hosting costs per month: shared hosting for the shop 9 EUR, the VPS 6 EUR, together 15 EUR.

engrams.title: hosting-costs-now
engrams.content: Since the shared hosting is cancelled, hosting is down to the one VPS: 6 EUR per month.

engrams.title: saturday-market
engrams.content: Weekly stall at the Saturday market on Karlsplatz, 8 to 13 o'clock; bring the folding table and the card reader.

engrams.title: markets-from-now-on
engrams.content: Gave up the Saturday stall at Karlsplatz. From now on only the Christmas market, on the first three weekends of December.

engrams.title: clay-minimum-order
engrams.content: The Westerwald clay supplier has raised the minimum order to 300 kg; the price per kg stays the same.

engrams.title: newsletter-subscribers
engrams.content: The newsletter crossed 800 subscribers after the Shopify launch giveaway.

engrams.title: revenue-so-far
engrams.content: Revenue so far this year according to lexoffice: about 19,200 EUR (as of the end of last month).

engrams.title: postage-rates
engrams.content: Postage: Warenpost 2.85 EUR per parcel up to 1 kg; DHL parcel up to 5 kg 5.49 EUR, insured.

engrams.title: packaging-cost
engrams.content: Packaging for a single mug costs about 1.90 EUR: box 1.20, honeycomb paper 0.50, tape and label 0.20.

engrams.title: studio
engrams.content: Kiln out of order until the new element is installed; production is paused.

engrams.title: kiln-element-broke
engrams.content: A kiln element broke during the glaze firing; replacement ordered, the kiln is out for about a week.

engrams.title: firing-temperatures
engrams.content: Bisque firing at 950 °C, glaze firing at 1240 °C; a full cycle including cool-down takes about 26 hours.

engrams.title: glaze-celadon
engrams.content: Celadon glaze: 40 % feldspar, 30 % silica, 20 % whiting, 10 % kaolin, plus 1.5 % iron oxide.

engrams.title: glaze-speckled-white
engrams.content: Speckled white: the base white glaze plus 2 % granular ilmenite; looks best on the grey stoneware.

engrams.title: clay-bodies
engrams.content: Two clay bodies in use: grey stoneware for mugs and bowls, white porcelain for the small vases.

engrams.title: studio-rent
engrams.content: Studio rent is 480 EUR per month, due on the 1st; the lease runs until the end of next year.

engrams.title: batch-size
engrams.content: Mugs are thrown in batches of 30; about 15 % are lost in firing or sorted out as seconds.

engrams.title: seconds-sale
engrams.content: Seconds with small flaws are sold at 40 % off in a separate shop collection once a quarter.

engrams.title: packaging
engrams.content: Every mug is wrapped in honeycomb paper and packed in a double-walled box; no plastic fill.

engrams.title: glaze-safety
engrams.content: All glazes are lead-free; the food-safety test for the celadon passed in spring.

engrams.title: kiln-maintenance
engrams.content: Check the kiln elements every 50 firings; vacuum the kiln and check the thermocouple at the same time.

engrams.title: photo-setup
engrams.content: Photo setup by the north window: white sweep, tripod, shoot between 10 and 14 o'clock.

engrams.title: studio-insurance
engrams.content: Studio contents are insured for 25,000 EUR; the kiln is listed separately.

engrams.title: cobalt-glaze-tests
engrams.content: Test tiles for a new cobalt blue: run 3 was too runny, run 4 looks promising, one more firing needed.

engrams.title: cobalt-glaze
engrams.content: Finish the cobalt blue glaze tests and decide whether it goes into the spring collection.

engrams.title: kiln-element
engrams.content: Install the replacement kiln element and do a test firing.

engrams.title: tableware-clay
engrams.content: Use the grey stoneware for all tableware.

properties.rationale: Chips less than porcelain in daily use and costs less.

engrams.title: workshops
engrams.content: Beginner wheel workshops twice a month on Saturdays, six places each, usually sold out.

engrams.title: workshop-pricing
engrams.content: Workshop price: 95 EUR per person for three hours, including clay, glazing and the firing of two pieces.

engrams.title: workshop-booking
engrams.content: Sell workshop places in the shop as a product with one variant per date.

properties.rationale: One checkout, one payment provider, stock count = free places.

engrams.title: workshop-confirmation-email
engrams.content: After booking, participants get an automatic email with directions, what to wear and when their pieces can be picked up.

engrams.title: workshop-pickup
engrams.content: Fired workshop pieces are ready for pick-up about three weeks after the workshop.

engrams.title: workshop-cancellation
engrams.content: Cancellation up to 7 days before the workshop: full refund; later: a voucher for another date.

engrams.title: christmas-workshop
engrams.content: Plan a Christmas special workshop in December: decorating ready-made mugs, eight places.

engrams.title: gift-vouchers
engrams.content: Workshop gift vouchers sell best in November and December; sold as a digital product in the shop.

engrams.title: october-workshops-sold-out
engrams.content: The October workshops sold out within two days of the announcement.

engrams.title: workshop-materials
engrams.content: Workshop clay: 1.5 kg per person; aprons and tools are provided.

engrams.title: wholesale
engrams.content: Two cafés buy wholesale; a third one in Mainz is interested.

engrams.title: wholesale-pricing
engrams.content: Wholesale price is 50 % of retail, minimum order 24 pieces.

properties.rationale: Keeps a margin after packaging and the extra handling.

engrams.title: cafe-kornblume
engrams.content: Café Kornblume orders 24 espresso cups every three months and pays by invoice within 14 days.

engrams.title: roastery-hafen
engrams.content: Rösterei Hafen orders mugs with their logo stamped in; the stamp was a one-off cost of 80 EUR.

engrams.title: mainz-offer
engrams.content: Send the wholesale offer to the café in Mainz, with photos of the speckled mug range.

engrams.title: wholesale-shipping
engrams.content: Wholesale orders above 60 pieces go on a pallet with a freight forwarder; smaller ones as DHL parcels.

engrams.title: wholesale-invoices
engrams.content: Wholesale invoices are written in lexoffice with 14 days payment terms.

engrams.title: roastery-order
engrams.content: Rösterei Hafen ordered 48 logo mugs.

engrams.title: discount-codes
engrams.content: Discount code WELCOME10 gives 10 % on the first order; codes are created in the Shopify admin.

engrams.title: customer-service
engrams.content: Customer emails are answered Monday to Friday within 24 hours.

engrams.title: gift-wrapping
engrams.content: Gift wrapping costs 3 EUR, offered as a checkbox at checkout.

engrams.title: best-sellers
engrams.content: Best sellers this year: the speckled mug, the celadon bowl and the small bud vase.

engrams.title: product-reviews
engrams.content: Product reviews are collected with a review app; 4.8 stars on average from 112 reviews.

engrams.title: abandoned-cart-email
engrams.content: The abandoned-cart email goes out after four hours, without a discount.

engrams.title: shipping-countries
engrams.content: Ship only within the EU.

properties.rationale: Customs paperwork for ceramics outside the EU is not worth it at this volume.

engrams.title: legal-texts
engrams.content: Imprint, terms and privacy policy come from a legal text service and update automatically.

engrams.title: app-icon
engrams.content: The app icon is the speckled mug on a sand background; source file in the design folder.

engrams.title: app-analytics
engrams.content: No analytics SDK in the app; crash reports only, through the Expo service.

engrams.title: dns
engrams.content: DNS is managed at the domain registrar; the shop domain points to Shopify, blog. subdomain to the VPS.

engrams.title: blog-comments
engrams.content: Comments on the blog are members-only to keep spam out.
